text:
celia: Planning a staged flip tonight in the 23:00 UTC window. Need quick sanity on cross-service pins and the emergency rollback path.

deploybot: Noted. Target: 23:00 UTC. Canary: 3% for 10m -> 20% for 10m -> 60% -> 100%. Will post checkpoints.

ian: Which artifacts and pins?

celia: api v4.0.0 (feature flag gated), runtime v2.15.0-rc (batching opt), router v1.10.0 (header split + weighted rules), console v0.29.0. Keep api v3.9.x and runtime v2.14.x as fallback.

ops-bot: FYI: stg cluster has a hot deployment at 22:45 UTC. Canaries must avoid that cluster until 23:10.

marco: For router header split, ops will apply this then pause for validation. Patch: ```json
{"split":{"header":"x-experiment","routes":[{"id":"legacy","weight":80},{"id":"new","weight":20}]}}
```

ian: Rollback gates? I want explicit metrics and an owner.

celia: Rollback gates (thresholds):
- api error-rate increase >4% sustained for 5m
- runtime p50 token latency +250ms vs baseline
- router 5xxs >2% of requests for 5m
- console frontend errors >1.5%
Owner: @ian primary, @marco secondary.

deploybot: Preflight: health checks green, migrations none, canary groups ready. Annotating release with gates and owners.

ian: During canary I'll watch API error budget and trace sampling. If gate hits, I will label thread with "rollback" and call deploybot revert.

marco: Ops runbook link: https://git.redwood/ops/releases/staged-flip. Includes backout router script and console toggle.

celia: Note: console flag NEW_BATCH_UI=false by default. We'll flip it only after 60% and verify traces.

deploybot: Canary started 23:00 UTC -> group-1 at 3%. Health probes running.

marco: quick smoke: login flow OK, embeddings producing similar latencies.

ian: token-cache miss +9% in first 5m, exceeding the expected noise (baseline +2%). Holding promotion.

celia: Hold confirmed. Do not promote to 20%. Ian, can you confirm whether to rollback or investigate?

ian: Investigating. Early signal looks like eviction threshold edge-case in runtime rc. Marco, can we temporarily increase KV cache size for canary nodes?

marco: Yes, applying a +10% mem limit to canary pool. Will post when done.

ops-bot: Canaries updated with mem bump at 23:08 UTC.

ian: After bump, miss rate back to +1%. Moving forward with promotion to 20% at 23:15 UTC.

deploybot: Promoted to 20% -> running 10m watch.

celia: Reminder to not route eu-central full traffic until 00:30 UTC due to local maintenance.

ian: Monitoring: API errors normal, runtime latency stable. No rollback.

deploybot: Promoting to 60% at 23:30 UTC.

marco: Router split verified, no anomalous 5xx spikes.

celia: Keep oncall looped if anything happens. If rollback triggered, rollback steps: 1) deploybot revert -> pinned artifacts (api 3.9.x, runtime 2.14.x, router 1.9.x), 2) ops runback router-swap script, 3) console toggle NEW_BATCH_UI=false + frontend rollback, 4) reopen canary with adjustments.

ian: Acknowledged. I'll signal rollback if thresholds breach.

deploybot: Full rollout to 100% at 23:45 UTC. All gates green. Marking release SUCCESS.

celia: Nice work. Will file a short release note and close thread in 24h unless regressions. :shipit:
